title: Batch data-worktree admission discovery and path inventory without weakening checks
outcome: Reduce Git subprocesses used by every data-worktree observation while retaining exact root, administration, branch, HEAD, history and complete path admission.
acceptance: A behavioral spawn-count regression measures representative empty and populated data-worktree observation before and after; the corrected observation uses a fixed small bound independent of unrelated files
Repository discovery and HEAD reads are batched, and complete cached plus ignored/unignored file inventory is read together, while existing rejection and code-preservation tests retain their strength
Focused Windows data-worktree tests and independent complete-input reviews pass on the exact candidate, with no deadline increase or global cache
